name: Harun (Aaron)
source: Stories of the Prophets — compiled from the Qur'an and authentic hadith
paras: Harun was the elder brother of Musa, born three years before him into the tribe of Israel in Egypt. When Allah commissioned Musa, he prayed: "And appoint for me a minister from my family — Harun, my brother. Increase my strength with him, and let him share my task, that we may exalt You much." (Ta-Ha 20:29-34).

Allah answered: "You are granted your request, O Musa." (Ta-Ha 20:36) — and Harun was made a prophet and a partner in the mission: "And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Harun as a prophet." (Maryam 19:53).

It was Harun whom Allah chose to speak for Musa, whose tongue was slow: "We will strengthen your arm with your brother, and We will give you both supremacy, so they will not reach you." (Al-Qasas 28:35). Together they stood before Pharaoh, the greatest tyrant of the earth.

When the magicians of Egypt fell prostrate and believed, Pharaoh threatened to crucify them; it was they — strengthened by the teaching of the two brothers — who answered: "We will never prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and over He who created us." (Ta-Ha 20:72).

Harun remained with the Israelites when Musa went to the appointment of forty nights on Mount Sinai. The weak-hearted among them gathered around the gold calf of the Samaritan, and Harun called them with the words of a merciful prophet: "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order." (Ta-Ha 20:90).

They refused, and when Musa returned in anger he seized his brother by the beard: "O Harun, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray, from following me?" Harun answered with dignity: "O son of my mother, do not seize me by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel.'" (Ta-Ha 20:92-94).
Allah Himself cleared Harun of every share in the calf, revealing to Musa: "We tried your people after you left, and the Samaritan led them astray." (Ta-Ha 20:85).

For years Harun stood with Musa before Pharaoh and through the wandering in the desert. The Qur'an counts him among the honoured messengers: "And mention in the Book, Musa. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger, a prophet... and We gave him from Our mercy his brother Harun as a prophet." (Maryam 19:51-53).

The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ said: "The prophets are brothers from one father; their mothers differ, and their religion is one." In that family of prophets, Harun is the brother-helper — the proof that no messenger carries the message alone.
